scene: The glistening water trail leads down to a busy multi-transit hub platform.
picture: Side view along a wide transit terrace. The grandfather stands centre pushing his bicycle with plant crate. On the far left sits a waiting yellow retro streetcar with folding doors open. On the right rises an elevated track with the streamlined bento express. Far right, a carved koi boat bobs beside a dock.
shown: a vintage yellow streetcar with open folding doors waiting on the far left
a sleek bento express shuttle idling with an open sliding door up high
a giant carved wooden koi-shaped boat moored at the far right canal dock
